newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA completes Transurban road finance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA completes Transurban road finance.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said on Thursday that it had completed the syndication of the A$1.178 billion project finance facility for the Transurban City Link toll motorway project.

Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd and Westpac Banking Corp were co lead arrangers with CBA, which noted in a statement that the syndication was almost 100 percent oversubscribed. The facility was syndicated to a total of 19 local and international banks.
The City Link project is funded by A$1.3 billion worth of debt and about A$500 million of infrastructure bonds which convert to shares and units in a trust in late 1999.
The project is under construction and is expected to be completed by December 1999.
